$comment: SAP HANA SQL / SQLScript word catalog (#77). Source of truth for highlighting, formatting, analyzer word sets and hover. Edit here, then run `npm run build:keywords`. Schema: docs/specs/SPEC_RULES.md §2.C.

ddl.description: Data definition keyword (statement verbs, object kinds, column and routine options).

word-operator.description: Logical operator or predicate written as a word (AND, IN, LIKE, BETWEEN, ...).

system-value.description: Niladic system value written without parentheses (CURRENT_DATE, SESSION_USER, SYSUUID, ...).
system-value.context: An operand. The same names followed by `(` are highlighted as functions.

annotation.description: SQLScript annotation written as `@Name` (compiler pragmas, `SQLSCRIPT_TEST` annotations, `@AnalyzerSuppress`) `[XSA]` `[HDI]` `[CLOUD]`.

sqlscript-keyword.description: SQLScript-only keyword (routine options, exception classes, library visibility, GraphScript traversal).

reserved.description: Reserved word: cannot be an unquoted identifier.

alter-system-word.description: Word of an `ALTER SYSTEM ...` statement head.
alter-system-word.context: Directly after `ALTER SYSTEM`. Elsewhere it is an ordinary word.

statement-noun.description: Object noun of a DDL statement head (`CREATE REMOTE SOURCE`, `ALTER WORKLOAD CLASS`, ...).
statement-noun.context: Within the first words of a CREATE / ALTER / DROP / ... statement or a headerless HDI artifact.

clause-word.description: Non-reserved word that is a keyword only inside a specific clause (window frames, hierarchy generators, series tables, JSON_TABLE, graph workspaces, ...).
clause-word.context: Only inside its clause; an ordinary identifier elsewhere.

keyword.description: Non-reserved keyword that the formatter cases as a keyword in any position.

quote-protected.description: Non-reserved word that `identifierQuotes: "removeUnnecessary"` must not unquote, because it is a keyword somewhere.

sql-statement-starter.description: First word of a documented SAP HANA SQL statement (`<X> Statement` chapters of the SQL Reference).

sqlscript-statement-starter.description: First word of a SQLScript imperative statement.
sqlscript-statement-starter.context: Statement start inside a procedure, function or DO block body.

general-sql-root.description: Valid first word of a top-level SQL statement or script; suppresses root typo QuickFixes.
general-sql-root.context: First token of a file or statement (HANA-SYN-021).

unambiguous-statement-start.description: Word that can only start a statement, so a preceding statement must have ended with `;`.
unambiguous-statement-start.context: Inside a SQLScript block (HANA-SYN-024 missing semicolon).

block-end-stop-prev.description: Word after which a following statement word does not need a separating `;`.
block-end-stop-prev.context: Previous token of a statement-start candidate (HANA-SYN-024). Combined with punctuation in `syntax.ts`.

statement-exit-word.description: Statement word that ends an open query when it begins a new line.
statement-exit-word.context: Line start after a FROM clause, in SQLScript bodies (clause order check).

statement-continuation-prev.description: Word after which a line-leading statement word continues the current query instead of starting a new statement.
statement-continuation-prev.context: Previous word of a `statement-exit-word` candidate (clause order check).

top-level-imperative.description: SQLScript imperative statement that is only valid inside a procedure, function or DO block body.
top-level-imperative.context: Top level of a plain SQL file.

terminator-statement.description: Statement that leaves the current block, making the rest of the block unreachable.

dml-write-statement.context: Statement start in a routine body (READS SQL DATA / read-only checks).

ddl-statement.context: Statement start in a routine body (read-only checks).

procedure-dml-statement.description: DML statement verb checked in procedure bodies by the SQLScript performance rules.
procedure-dml-statement.context: First keyword of a statement inside a procedure body.

procedure-ddl-statement.description: DDL statement verb checked in procedure bodies by the SQLScript performance rules.
procedure-ddl-statement.context: First keyword of a statement inside a procedure body.

select-privilege-prev.description: Word before `SELECT` that makes `SELECT` a privilege name, not a query (clause order check).

select-privilege-prev-clause.description: Word before `SELECT` that makes `SELECT` a privilege name, not a query (incomplete-clause check).

subselect-context.description: Statement word after which a nested `SELECT` belongs to the same statement (no `;` expected before it).
subselect-context.context: Top paren depth of a statement (HANA-SYN-024).

set-statement-object.description: Word after `SET` that makes it a `SET <object>` statement rather than an `UPDATE ... SET col = <expr>` assignment.

end-compound-suffix.description: Word after `END` that closes a compound statement (`END IF`, `END LOOP`, `END WHILE`, `END FOR`).

end-suffix.description: Word after `END` that closes a compound statement or a `CASE` expression.

block-stop.description: SQLScript block word that ends an embedded SQL statement.
block-stop.context: Clause parser follow sets inside SQLScript blocks.

if-body-stop.description: Word that ends the statement list of an `IF` / `ELSEIF` branch.
if-body-stop.context: Statement list of an IF statement.

case-body-stop.description: Word that ends the statement list of a `CASE` statement branch.
case-body-stop.context: Statement list of a CASE statement.

body-statement-word.description: Word that may start a statement in a SQLScript body; any other word at a statement boundary is checked as a keyword typo.
body-statement-word.context: Statement boundary in a SQLScript block (HANA-SYN-021).

body-typo-target.description: SQLScript keyword suggested by the statement-boundary typo QuickFix.
body-typo-target.context: Statement boundary in a SQLScript block (HANA-SYN-021).

compound-boundary-prev.description: Word after which the next token starts a new SQLScript statement.
compound-boundary-prev.context: Previous token at a SQLScript statement boundary. Combined with `;` and `:` in `syntax.ts`.

library-member-starter.description: Word that may start a member declaration of a SQLScript library.

routine-header-opener.description: Word that opens a construct parsed by the routine header parser.

routine-clause-starter.description: First word of a routine header clause before `AS`.

routine-language.description: Value of `LANGUAGE` in a routine header.

routine-language-typo-target.description: Language suggested by the routine header `LANGUAGE` typo QuickFix.

routine-management-action.description: Action of an `ALTER PROCEDURE` / `ALTER FUNCTION` management statement (not a header redefinition).

ddl-noun.description: Object noun that may follow a DDL verb.
ddl-noun.context: After CREATE / ALTER / DROP (HANA-SYN-021 object keyword check).

ddl-modifier.description: Modifier that may sit between a DDL verb and its object noun.
ddl-modifier.context: After CREATE / ALTER / DROP, before the object noun.

ddl-typo-target.description: Object noun suggested by the DDL object keyword typo QuickFix.

migration-table-root.description: Headerless root of a `.hdbmigrationtable` version section `[HDI]` `[CLOUD]`.
migration-table-root.context: First word after a `== version = N` marker.

table-columns-prev.description: Word before `TABLE (` that makes the parenthesis a column definition list.
table-columns-prev.context: `RETURNS TABLE (...)`, `CREATE COLUMN TABLE t (...)`, `IN p TABLE (...)`.

on-target-ddl-noun.description: DDL object noun whose `ON <name> (...)` parenthesis is a column list, not a call.

table-constraint-starter.description: Word that starts a table constraint or index in a CREATE TABLE element list.
table-constraint-starter.context: Start of a CREATE TABLE element (clause parser).

column-list-constraint-starter.description: Word that starts a table constraint (or `LIKE`) instead of a column definition.
column-list-constraint-starter.context: Start of an element of a column definition list (HANA-SYN-023).

column-end-modifier.description: Column definition modifier that may end a column definition.
column-end-modifier.context: After the data type in a column definition (HANA-SYN-023).

column-clause-modifier.description: Column definition clause keyword (`DEFAULT`, `GENERATED`, `FUZZY SEARCH INDEX`, `BTREE`, ...).

type-with-args.description: Data type that takes a length / precision argument list.
type-with-args.context: `<type> (` in a column or parameter definition.

type-length-unit.description: Length unit inside a data type argument list (`NVARCHAR(10 CHAR)`).
type-length-unit.context: Inside a data type argument list.

unquoted-default.description: Column default that classic `.hdbtable` writes as a quoted string but HDI must write unquoted `[XSC]` -> `[HDI]`.

query-clause.description: Keyword that ends a query expression or clause at the same nesting level.
query-clause.context: Clause parser follow sets. Listed in clause order: the order of the HANA-SYN-042 "expected ..." message.

join-starter.description: Word that starts a join, including the cardinality prefixes `MANY` / `ONE` / `EXACT`.
join-starter.context: FROM clause only. `LEFT (` / `RIGHT (` are string function calls.

non-alias.description: Word that is never an implicit alias, because it continues or ends the enclosing clause.
non-alias.context: After a table reference or select item (clause parser).

follow-hidden.description: Follow-set word left out of the HANA-SYN-042 "expected ..." message.

reserved-operand.description: Reserved word usable as an operand (niladic system value or pseudo-column).

typed-literal-prefix.description: Data type that prefixes a typed literal (`DATE '2024-01-01'`).

interval-unit.description: Interval qualifier word (`INTERVAL '1' DAY TO SECOND`).

datetime-field.context: First argument of `EXTRACT`; a keyword when followed by `FROM`.

query-start-prev.description: Word after which a query may start without a separating `;`.
query-start-prev.context: Previous token of `SELECT` / `WITH`. Combined with `;`, `(` and `:=` in `syntax.ts`.

comparison-word.description: Predicate word that may follow a column operand.
comparison-word.context: Second token after a column operand. Combined with comparison operators in `syntax.ts`.

select-stop-clause.description: Keyword that ends a select list.

select-prefix-op.description: Word that continues a select item expression (operator words, `OVER`, `FILTER`, `WITHIN`, ...).
select-prefix-op.context: Select list. Combined with operators in `syntax.ts`.

incomplete-from-follow.description: Clause keyword that cannot directly follow `FROM` (missing table reference).

incomplete-where-follow.description: Keyword that cannot directly follow `WHERE` (missing condition).

incomplete-having-follow.description: Keyword that cannot directly follow `HAVING` (missing condition).

ident-context.description: Keyword after which dynamic SQL concatenates an identifier, not a value.
ident-context.context: End of a dynamic SQL string before `||` (SQL injection rule).

expr-clause-terminator.description: Keyword that ends an expression (dangling-operator check).
expr-clause-terminator.context: Expression scanning (HANA-SYN-023). `LEFT (` / `RIGHT (` are calls, not terminators.

expr-prefix-word.description: Word that expects an operand after it (unary / prefix keyword).

expr-infix-direct.description: Infix predicate word that needs an operand on both sides.

expr-infix-after-not.description: Predicate word that forms an infix operator with a preceding `NOT` (`NOT IN`, `NOT LIKE`, ...).

window-order-modifier.description: Sort modifier in `ORDER BY` and window specifications.

nondeterministic-call.description: Function whose result changes between calls; a DETERMINISTIC function must not call it.
nondeterministic-call.context: Followed by `(` in a DETERMINISTIC function body.

nondeterministic-value.description: Niladic system value that changes between calls.
nondeterministic-value.context: Operand in a DETERMINISTIC function body.

special-call.description: Function with clause syntax in its argument list (`CAST(x AS t)`, `EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d)`, `TRIM(BOTH ...)`), so comma checking is skipped.

hierarchy-clause-function.description: Hierarchy generator or navigation function with clause syntax (`SOURCE ... START WHERE ... DEPTH ...`).

hierarchy-clause.description: Top-level clause keyword of a hierarchy function; ends a preceding `START WHERE` / `WHERE` / `JOIN ... ON` condition.
hierarchy-clause.context: Only inside `HIERARCHY*( ... )` argument lists: the words are non-reserved elsewhere.

json-clause-function.description: JSON function that takes space-separated clauses after its path argument.

json-call-clause.context: Only inside JSON_VALUE / JSON_QUERY argument lists.

json-column-trailing.description: Word that may follow a complete `JSON_TABLE` column definition.

call-infix-or-clause.description: Word that may appear between arguments of a function call (clause keywords, `AS`, `RESPECT NULLS`, ...).
call-infix-or-clause.context: Inside a function call argument list (HANA-SYN-023).

call-prefix-word.description: Word that may start a function argument (`DISTINCT`, `ALL`, `NOT`, ...).
call-prefix-word.context: Start of a function call argument.

call-prefix-no-op.description: Keyword before `<name> (` that makes the parenthesis a call or definition, not an operand.

paren-expression-prev.description: Keyword before `(` that introduces a parenthesized expression, subquery or clause, not a call argument list.

fmt-join-starter.description: Word that starts a join phrase on a new line.

fmt-join-phrase.description: Word that may appear inside a join phrase before `JOIN`.

fmt-begin-modifier.description: Modifier after `BEGIN` that stays on the `BEGIN` line.

fmt-object-type.description: Object kind that ends a DDL statement head.

fmt-statement-verb.description: Statement verb after which `statement-noun` words are cased as keywords.

fmt-hdi-first.description: First word of a headerless HDI artifact statement.
fmt-hdi-first.context: First word of an HDI design-time file.

fmt-header-word.description: Routine header clause word that starts a new header line.

fmt-non-value.description: Keyword after which `+` / `-` is unary and `*` a wildcard, not a binary operator.
